name: Levison Enterprises
old_description: When your industrial electronics, devices, or power supplies fail, you need to find an electronics repair solution quickly. Levison Enterprises specializes in electronic repair services tailored to fix current and legacy electronic projects and keep your operations running smoothly. Even when original PCB or Gerber files are unavailable, our experienced engineering team can diagnose and repair issues.
about:
Levison Enterprises operates from a 15,000-square-foot facility in Millbury, Ohio, where it has been based since 2014. The company began as an AC plasma display manufacturer with in-house electronic manufacturing capabilities. As printed circuit board technology advanced and demand for plasma displays waned, the engineering team pivoted to become a full-service electronic contract manufacturer and sub-assembly provider. The business is organized as a limited liability company led by President David M. Levison.

The company provides turnkey electronic manufacturing services including printed circuit board assembly, cable and wire harness fabrication, electronic repair and diagnostics, PCB design and engineering, rapid prototyping, and legacy product repair with reverse engineering. Its facility features ESD-safe epoxy flooring, semi-truck access, and on-site engineering and supply chain management. Levison holds AS9100, ISO 9001, and ISO 13485 certifications through NSF-ISR, is ITAR registered, and complies with IPC and J-STD standards while working toward CMMC compliance.

Levison serves military and aerospace, medical device, food safety, industrial, and defense customers. Case studies reference Seagate Mobile Security Solutions for security systems, EPI Global for legacy displays dating to the 1960s, and international clients who value faster shipping and engineering responsiveness. The company also supports design engineers who need a manufacturing partner for prototype through production runs.

Levison emphasizes a culture of continuous improvement, targeting 100% quality, on-time delivery, and customer satisfaction. Its differentiators include a vetted domestic supply chain with counterfeit-part mitigation, on-site engineers for real-time problem solving, PFMEA-driven process controls, and a single-project-manager model for turnkey programs. The company was founded to bridge the gap between design and reliable domestic manufacturing, especially for regulated industries.
